capabilities.description: Derive a reusable capability-level graph, bounded candidate pipelines, goal queries, and explicit missing-provider/adapter leads from an analyzed Monolith snapshot.

Export explicit checked-in Monolith assembly-control state as a strict AXM Machine Voice notice snapshot. The first rule surfaces only an explicit build hold and assigns no importance, anomaly, failure, recommendation, or other interpretation.

module.name: axm-monolith
module.purpose: On-demand assembly, inspection, capability/pipeline discovery, bounded testing, and explicit state handoff for the public AXM stack without erasing source identity.

truth_boundary: Pipeline discovery is candidate evidence only. Machine Voice export is a state-contract handoff only and is not cross-repository runtime verification. This manifest grants no automatic execution, merge, CANON, installation, device, network, or assembly authority.
